fact: The pay-kit interop harness uses ImplementationDefinition objects to register server and client adapters. Each adapter has: id (unique string), label (human name), role (client|server), command (argv array to spawn), enabled (from env var), intents (charge|x402-exact), reportsAs (language tag the fixture emits in its JSON). The harness validates that the running fixture's `implementation` field matches `reportsAs` — a mismatch fails the test loudly.
recommendation: When adding a new harness adapter, always set reportsAs to the bare language tag the fixture actually emits ('typescript', 'rust', 'go'), not the adapter id. See harness/src/implementations.ts for all existing adapter definitions.

fact: The clawd-x402 harness adapter entry opts in via `X402_INTEROP_SERVERS=clawd-x402` env var. It is disabled by default (enabled: false) because it requires a funded fee payer keypair and live mainnet access. The command `sh -c 'cd ../demo/clawd-server && pnpm start'` is run relative to the harness/ directory, so the path resolves to pay-kit/demo/clawd-server/. It reports as 'typescript' (the underlying SDK language).
recommendation: To run clawd-x402 in the harness: `X402_INTEROP_SERVERS=clawd-x402 FEE_PAYER_KEY=<base58> pnpm test` from the harness/ directory. Always test with X402_INTEROP_CLIENTS=ts-x402 for the TS client to confirm end-to-end.

fact: The clawd-app demo frontend is a Vite + React app at pay-kit/demo/clawd-app/. It renders a list of 11 endpoint cards from endpoints.ts, lets users pick an endpoint, shows the mppx.fetch() code snippet via buildSnippet(), and executes the call against the local demo server. The app generates real mppx client code that users can copy into their own agents.
recommendation: When adding new endpoints to the demo server, also add them to pay-kit/demo/clawd-app/src/endpoints.ts with correct cost, method, path, and body. The buildSnippet() function auto-generates the client code from the endpoint definition.

fact: pay.sh PHASE 4 opens three URLs post-install using the _open_url helper: x402.wtf/gateway, x402.wtf/agents, x402.wtf/skills. These are the three main dashboards for the Clawd agent platform. The browser opens are fire-and-forget (backgrounded) and run after the Convex install telemetry POST. All three open simultaneously in the user's default browser.
recommendation: When adding new post-install browser opens to pay.sh, add them in the same _open_url block after the gateway registration. Always open in the background — never block on browser opens. Only open URLs that are user-facing dashboards, never internal or admin pages.

Public free chat streams via OpenRouter POST /api/v1/chat/completions; verified holders stream via xAI Responses (Grok 4.5) with previous_response_id chaining. fact: OpenRouter free inference for CLAWD Bot supports two model forms: (1) Free Models Router openrouter/free which auto-selects an available free model filtered for request features; (2) pinned free variants by appending :free to a model id (e.g. cohere/north-mini-code:free). Free models may have different rate limits/availability than paid.
recommendation: Default to openrouter/free for zero-cost availability. Pin a specific :free model via OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL or OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD when behavior must be stable. Prefer paid models for high-reliability production traffic.
